clips.title: Greece was twice as rich as Poland in 2008. Not anymore #Shorts
clips.desc: 2008: $31.7k vs $14.0k per person. 2024: Poland passed Greece. 2025: Croatia too (World Bank).

clips.title: 12 EU countries passed Greece since 2008 #Shorts
